name: admin_release_report
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_release_report(p jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
 kind text; filter_category text; st text; filter_quantity integer; lim integer; off integer;
 start_at timestamptz; end_at timestamptz; result jsonb;
begin
 if not public.admin_operator() then raise sqlstate 'PT401' using message='OPERATOR_REQUIRED'; end if;
 if jsonb_typeof(p) is distinct from 'object' or
  p-array['version','kind','from','to','category','state','quantity','limit','offset']<>'{}'::jsonb or
  p->>'version' is distinct from 'admin-release-v1' then raise sqlstate 'PT422' using message='INVALID_REQUEST'; end if;
 kind:=p->>'kind'; filter_category:=coalesce(p->>'category','all'); st:=coalesce(p->>'state','all');
 start_at:=coalesce((p->>'from')::timestamptz,'-infinity'); end_at:=coalesce((p->>'to')::timestamptz,'infinity');
 lim:=coalesce((p->>'limit')::integer,25); off:=coalesce((p->>'offset')::integer,0); filter_quantity:=(p->>'quantity')::integer;
 if kind is null or kind not in ('dashboard','credit','payment') or start_at>=end_at or
  lim not between 1 and 50 or off not between 0 and 1000000 or
  filter_category not in ('all','purchase','free','admin','consume','expiration','reversal') or
  st not in ('all','paid','cancelled') or (filter_quantity is not null and filter_quantity not in (1,3,5,10))
 then raise sqlstate 'PT422' using message='INVALID_FILTER'; end if;
 if kind='credit' then
  with classified as (
   select t.id,t.created_at,t.transaction_type,t.balance_delta,t.reserved_delta,g.origin,
    case when t.transaction_type='purchase' then 'purchase'
     when t.transaction_type in ('signup_bonus','promotion','compensation','b2b_program') then 'free'
     when t.transaction_type='admin_grant' then 'admin'
     when t.transaction_type='consume' then 'consume'
     when t.transaction_type='expiration' then 'expiration'
     when t.transaction_type in ('refund','adjustment') then 'reversal' else 'reservation' end category
   from public.credit_transactions t join public.credit_grants g on g.id=t.grant_id
   where t.created_at>=start_at and t.created_at<end_at
  ), filtered as (select * from classified where filter_category='all' or classified.category=filter_category),
  page as (select * from filtered order by created_at desc,id desc limit lim offset off)
  select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from filtered),
   'balance_delta',(select coalesce(sum(balance_delta),0) from filtered),
   'reserved_delta',(select coalesce(sum(reserved_delta),0) from filtered),
   'categories',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.category) from
    (select category,count(*) count,coalesce(sum(balance_delta),0) balance_delta from filtered group by category) x),'[]'::jsonb),
   'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) order by created_at desc,id desc) from page),'[]'::jsonb)) into result;
 elsif kind='payment' then
  with filtered as (
   select o.* from public.payment_orders o where o.created_at>=start_at and o.created_at<end_at
    and (filter_quantity is null or o.quantity=filter_quantity)
    and (st='all' or st='paid' and o.state='PAID' or st='cancelled' and o.state in ('CANCELLED','PARTIALLY_CANCELLED'))
  ), page as (select id,sku,quantity,amount,currency,mode,state,grant_state,created_at,paid_at from filtered order by created_at desc,id desc limit lim offset off)
  select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from filtered),
   'paid',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.mode,x.currency) from
    (select mode,currency,count(*) count,sum(amount) amount from filtered where state='PAID' group by mode,currency) x),'[]'::jsonb),
   'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) order by created_at desc,id desc) from page),'[]'::jsonb)) into result;
 else
  select jsonb_build_object(
   'new_members',(select count(*) from public.profiles where created_at>=start_at and created_at<end_at),
   'credit_granted',(select coalesce(sum(balance_delta),0) from public.credit_transactions where created_at>=start_at and created_at<end_at and transaction_type in ('purchase','signup_bonus','promotion','admin_grant','compensation','b2b_program')),
   'credit_used',(select coalesce(-sum(balance_delta),0) from public.credit_transactions where created_at>=start_at and created_at<end_at and transaction_type='consume'),
   'paid',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.mode,x.currency) from
    (select mode,currency,count(*) count,sum(amount) amount from public.payment_orders where paid_at>=start_at and paid_at<end_at and state='PAID' group by mode,currency) x),'[]'::jsonb),
   'essay',(select jsonb_build_object('pending',count(*) filter(where state='reserved'),'completed',count(*) filter(where state='completed'),'failed',count(*) filter(where state='failed')) from essay_exam_private.runs where created_at>=start_at and created_at<end_at),
   'study_seconds',(select coalesce(sum(greatest(duration_seconds,0)),0) from public.study_sessions where include_in_study_total is true and ended_at is not null and started_at>=start_at and started_at<end_at),
   'registry',jsonb_build_object('exams',(select count(*) from public.essay_exams),'universities',(select count(distinct university_id) from public.essay_exams),'published_questions',(select count(*) from public.essay_questions where is_published is true))
  ) into result;
 end if;
 return result||jsonb_build_object('version','admin-release-v1','kind',kind,'as_of',statement_timestamp(),'limit',lim,'offset',off);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_mobile_purchase_report(p_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_quantity integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

BEGIN
 IF NOT public.admin_operator() OR NOT account_private.allowed(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE SQLSTATE '42501' USING MESSAGE='OPERATOR_REQUIRED'; END IF;
 IF coalesce(p_from,'-infinity')>=coalesce(p_to,'infinity') OR (p_quantity IS NOT NULL AND p_quantity NOT IN (1,3,5,10)) THEN RAISE SQLSTATE '22023' USING MESSAGE='INVALID_FILTER'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('version','admin-mobile-purchase-v1','as_of',statement_timestamp(),'basis','CREDIT_GRANTED_AT','amount_available',false,'environment_available',false,
 'platforms',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.platform) FROM (
 SELECT CASE t.reason_code WHEN 'iap_apple_v1' THEN 'apple' ELSE 'google' END platform,
 count(*) purchase_count,sum(t.balance_delta) granted_credits
 FROM public.credit_transactions t JOIN public.credit_grants g ON g.id=t.grant_id
 WHERE g.origin='purchase' AND t.transaction_type='purchase' AND t.reason_code IN ('iap_apple_v1','iap_google_v1')
 AND t.created_at>=coalesce(p_from,'-infinity') AND t.created_at<coalesce(p_to,'infinity')
 AND (p_quantity IS NULL OR t.balance_delta=p_quantity)
 GROUP BY t.reason_code) s),'[]'::jsonb));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_credit_member_list(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_sort text DEFAULT 'balance_desc'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare q text:=btrim(coalesce(p_query,''));qid uuid;result jsonb;
begin
 if not public.admin_operator() or not account_private.allowed(auth.uid()) then
  raise sqlstate '42501' using message='OPERATOR_REQUIRED';
 end if;
 if length(q)>254 or p_limit is null or p_limit not in (10,20,50)
 or p_offset is null or p_offset<0 or p_sort is null
 or p_sort not in ('balance_desc','balance_asc','granted_desc','used_desc','joined_desc') then
  raise sqlstate '22023' using message='INVALID_FILTER';
 end if;
 if q ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then qid:=q::uuid;end if;
 with members as materialized (
  select u.id account_id,u.email::text email,u.created_at,u.last_sign_in_at,a.id credit_account_id
  from auth.users u left join public.credit_accounts a on a.user_id=u.id
  where q='' or (qid is not null and u.id=qid) or
    (qid is null and strpos(lower(coalesce(u.email,'')),lower(q))>0)
 ), balances as materialized (
  select m.*,coalesce(public.admin_credit_snapshot(m.credit_account_id),
   '{"spendable":0,"reserved":0,"paid":0,"free":0,"other":0}'::jsonb) summary,
   (select max(g.created_at) from public.credit_grants g where g.account_id=m.credit_account_id) last_granted_at,
   (select max(t.created_at) from public.credit_transactions t where t.account_id=m.credit_account_id and t.transaction_type='consume') last_used_at
  from members m
 ), ranked as (
  select *,row_number() over(order by
   case when p_sort='balance_desc' then (summary->>'spendable')::bigint end desc nulls last,
   case when p_sort='balance_asc' then (summary->>'spendable')::bigint end asc nulls last,
   case when p_sort='granted_desc' then last_granted_at end desc nulls last,
   case when p_sort='used_desc' then last_used_at end desc nulls last,
   case when p_sort='joined_desc' then created_at end desc nulls last,
   account_id) ordinal from balances
 ), page as (select * from ranked order by ordinal limit p_limit offset p_offset)
 select jsonb_build_object('version','admin-credit-members-v1','as_of',statement_timestamp(),
  'total',(select count(*) from members),'limit',p_limit,'offset',p_offset,
  'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'account_id',account_id,'email',email,'summary',summary,
   'created_at',created_at,'last_sign_in_at',last_sign_in_at,
   'last_granted_at',last_granted_at,'last_used_at',last_used_at
  ) order by ordinal) from page),'[]'::jsonb)) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_summary()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid=essay_private.uid(); result jsonb;
begin
 if u is null then raise sqlstate 'PT401' using message='AUTH_REQUIRED';end if;
 perform account_private.lock_subject(u);
 if not account_private.allowed(u) then raise sqlstate 'PT403' using message='ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED';end if;
 with grants as (
 select g.id,g.origin,g.expires_at,coalesce(sum(t.balance_delta),0) balance,coalesce(sum(t.reserved_delta),0) reserved,
 exists(select 1 from public.payment_orders o where o.grant_id=g.id and o.state='CANCEL_PENDING') fenced
 from public.credit_accounts a join public.credit_grants g on g.account_id=a.id
 left join public.credit_transactions t on t.grant_id=g.id where a.user_id=u
 group by g.id
 ), spend as(select *,greatest(0,balance-reserved) available from grants where (expires_at is null or expires_at>statement_timestamp()) and not fenced)
 select jsonb_build_object('dto_version','credit-v1','as_of',statement_timestamp(),
 'spendable',coalesce(sum(available),0),'paid',coalesce(sum(available) filter(where origin='purchase'),0),
 'free',coalesce(sum(available) filter(where origin='signup_bonus'),0),
 'other',coalesce(sum(available) filter(where origin not in ('purchase','signup_bonus')),0),
 'reserved',coalesce(sum(reserved),0),'next_expiry',min(expires_at) filter(where available>0)) into result from spend;
 return result;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_credit_snapshot(p_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb; fenced uuid[] := array[]::uuid[];
begin
 if p_account_id is null then return null; end if;
 -- Match credit_summary without requiring the optional payment subsystem.
 if to_regclass('public.payment_orders') is not null then
  execute $$select coalesce(array_agg(o.grant_id) filter (where o.grant_id is not null),array[]::uuid[]) from public.payment_orders o where o.state='CANCEL_PENDING'$$ into fenced;
 end if;
 with g as (
  select gr.id,gr.origin,gr.expires_at,
   coalesce(sum(t.balance_delta),0) balance,coalesce(sum(t.reserved_delta),0) reserved
  from public.credit_grants gr left join public.credit_transactions t on t.grant_id=gr.id
  where gr.account_id=p_account_id group by gr.id
 ), s as (
  select *,greatest(0,balance-reserved) available from g
  where (expires_at is null or expires_at>statement_timestamp()) and not (id=any(fenced))
 )
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'spendable',coalesce(sum(available),0),
  'paid',coalesce(sum(available) filter (where origin='purchase'),0),
  'free',coalesce(sum(available) filter (where origin='signup_bonus'),0),
  'other',coalesce(sum(available) filter (where origin not in ('purchase','signup_bonus')),0),
  'reserved',coalesce(sum(reserved),0),
  'next_expiry',min(expires_at) filter (where available>0)
 ) into result from s;
 return result;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_dashboard()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb; fenced uuid[] := array[]::uuid[];
begin
 if not public.admin_operator() then raise sqlstate 'PT401' using message='OPERATOR_REQUIRED'; end if;
 -- Match credit_summary without requiring the optional payment subsystem.
 if to_regclass('public.payment_orders') is not null then
  execute $$select coalesce(array_agg(o.grant_id) filter (where o.grant_id is not null),array[]::uuid[]) from public.payment_orders o where o.state='CANCEL_PENDING'$$ into fenced;
 end if;
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'dto_version','admin-v1',
  'as_of',statement_timestamp(),
  'members',jsonb_build_object(
   'total',(select count(*) from public.profiles),
   'new_today',(select count(*) from public.profiles p where p.created_at>=date_trunc('day',statement_timestamp())),
   'new_7d',(select count(*) from public.profiles p where p.created_at>statement_timestamp()-interval '7 days'),
   'new_30d',(select count(*) from public.profiles p where p.created_at>statement_timestamp()-interval '30 days'),
   'active_30d',(select count(distinct s.user_id) from public.study_sessions s where s.started_at>statement_timestamp()-interval '30 days')
  ),
  'profile',jsonb_build_object(
   'grade_distribution',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',g.k,'count',g.c) order by g.c desc,g.k) from (
     select coalesce(p.grade_level::text,'UNKNOWN') k,count(*) c from public.profiles p group by 1) g),'[]'::jsonb),
   'school_distribution',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('school_code',s.code,'count',s.c) order by s.c desc,s.code) from (
     select p.neis_school_code code,count(*) c from public.profiles p where p.neis_school_code is not null group by 1 order by c desc,code limit 20) s),'[]'::jsonb),
   'school_distribution_by_identity',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('school_code',s.code,'school_office_code',s.office,'count',s.c) order by s.c desc,s.office,s.code) from (
     select p.neis_office_code office,p.neis_school_code code,count(*) c
     from public.profiles p where p.neis_school_code is not null
     group by p.neis_office_code,p.neis_school_code
     order by c desc,office,code limit 20) s),'[]'::jsonb),
   'school_unset_count',(select count(*) from public.profiles where neis_school_code is null),
   'school_code_note','school names are not stored; distribution is by NEIS school code only'
  ),
  'essay',jsonb_build_object(
   'submissions',(select count(*) from public.essay_attempts a where a.submitted_at is not null),
   'evaluation_requests',(select count(*) from public.essay_evaluations),
   'evaluation_completed',(select count(*) from public.essay_evaluations e where e.status='completed'),
   'evaluation_failed',(select count(*) from public.essay_evaluations e where e.status='failed'),
   'rewrites',(select count(*) from public.essay_attempts a where a.attempt_no>1),
   'reevaluations',(select count(*) from public.essay_evaluations e where e.supersedes_evaluation_id is not null)
  ),
  'math',jsonb_build_object(
   'installed',(to_regclass('public.math_attempts') is not null),
   'runtime_state','RUNTIME_OFF',
   'runtime_label','수리논술 평가 기능 비활성 (운영 준비 중)',
   'attempts',public.admin_count('public.math_attempts'),
   'evaluations',public.admin_count('public.math_evaluations')
  ),
  'credit',(
   with g as (
    select gr.id,gr.origin,gr.expires_at,
     coalesce(sum(t.balance_delta),0) balance,coalesce(sum(t.reserved_delta),0) reserved
    from public.credit_grants gr left join public.credit_transactions t on t.grant_id=gr.id group by gr.id
   ), s as (
    select *,greatest(0,balance-reserved) available from g
    where (expires_at is null or expires_at>statement_timestamp()) and not (id=any(fenced))
   )
   select jsonb_build_object(
    'spendable',coalesce(sum(available),0),
    'available_by_origin',jsonb_build_object(
     'signup_bonus',coalesce(sum(available) filter (where origin='signup_bonus'),0),
     'purchase',coalesce(sum(available) filter (where origin='purchase'),0),
     'promotion',coalesce(sum(available) filter (where origin='promotion'),0),
     'admin_grant',coalesce(sum(available) filter (where origin='admin_grant'),0),
     'compensation',coalesce(sum(available) filter (where origin='compensation'),0),
     'b2b_program',coalesce(sum(available) filter (where origin='b2b_program'),0),
     'other',coalesce(sum(available) filter (where origin not in ('signup_bonus','purchase','promotion','admin_grant','compensation','b2b_program')),0)
    ),
    'expiring_30d',coalesce(sum(available) filter (where expires_at is not null and expires_at<=statement_timestamp()+interval '30 days'),0),
    'granted_total',(select coalesce(sum(t.balance_delta),0) from public.credit_transactions t where t.balance_delta>0),
    'consumed_total',(select coalesce(-sum(t.balance_delta),0) from public.credit_transactions t where t.balance_delta<0)
   ) from s
  ),
  'payment',jsonb_build_object(
   'installed',(to_regclass('public.payment_orders') is not null),
   'runtime_state','LIVE_OFF',
   'runtime_label','결제 기능 미활성 (실결제 아님)',
   'orders',public.admin_count('public.payment_orders')
  )
 ) into result;
 return result;
end$function$
